lines.text: Ever tried to hold your whole life together with your own two hands? Romans twelve, one.
I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice,
holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
Surrender is not losing. It is putting the keys in the right hands. Give Him the plans, the habits, and the fear.
Lord, take all of me today. Amen. Have a blessed day.
